sloka: नाहं बन्धुजनैर्हीना हीना नाथेन तु त्वया ।विहीना कामभोगैश्च शोचिष्ये शाश्वतीः समाः ।। ६.११४.५९ ।।
transliteration: nāhaṁ bandhujanairhīnā hīnā nāthena tu tvayā ।vihīnā kāmabhogaiśca śociṣye śāśvatīḥ samāḥ ।। 6.114.59 ।।

translations.english: "When my son Indrajith was killed by Lakshmana I was in intense grief. Now you have fallen."
